description: This file contains the implementation of the SubscriptionMultiplicityTestRunner class, which provides various test methods for streaming subscription scenarios in Orleans, a distributed virtual actor framework. The class facilitates tests such as parallel subscriptions, linear subscriptions, add/remove subscriptions, resubscriptions, and client subscriptions, emphasizing subscription management and message production/consumption validation within a test cluster environment.

classes.name: SubscriptionMultiplicityTestRunner
classes.description: A test runner class providing methods to test various subscription scenarios in Orleans streaming, including parallel, linear, add/remove, resubscription, and client subscription tests.

methods.name: MultipleParallelSubscriptionTest
methods.description: Tests multiple parallel subscriptions, message production, and validation of subscription counters.

methods.name: MultipleLinearSubscriptionTest
methods.description: Tests sequential subscriptions, start/stop producing, count checks, and validation across multiple subscriptions.

methods.name: MultipleSubscriptionTest_AddRemove
methods.description: Tests adding and removing subscriptions dynamically with message production and counter validation.

methods.name: ResubscriptionTest
methods.description: Tests resuming a subscription after completion, validating continuity.

methods.name: ResubscriptionAfterDeactivationTest
methods.description: Tests resubscription behavior after grain deactivation, ensuring resilience.

methods.name: ActiveSubscriptionTest
methods.description: Validates active management of multiple subscriptions, including creation, verification, and removal.

methods.name: TwoIntermitentStreamTest
methods.description: Tests streaming over two different stream namespaces, including intermittent production.

methods.name: SubscribeFromClientTest
methods.description: Tests subscribing directly from a client, message validation, and unsubscription.

methods.name: CheckCounters
methods.description: Helper method to verify production and consumption counts for producer and consumer grains.

methods.name: RunFor
methods.description: Helper method to run a given asynchronous function repeatedly for a specified duration.
